title: Tournaments with Managerial Discretion
title_zh: 管理层自由裁量权下的锦标赛
title_primary: 管理层自由裁量权下的锦标赛
title_secondary: Tournaments with Managerial Discretion
authors: Peiran Xiao, Hashim Zaman
official: 官方在线 2026-09-07 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study tournaments with managerial discretion in hiring. A manager selects a coworker from a pool of candidates and then competes against him in a Lazear--Rosen--style tournament with a prize equal to a share of total output. A profit-maximizing principal sets the prize share together with a head start (or handicap)---an advantage (or disadvantage) in the output comparison---granted to the manager. The head start affects output through three channels: (i) encouraging the manager, (ii) discouraging the new hire, and (iii) inducing the manager to hire a stronger candidate. The hiring effect dominates the discouragement effect until the strongest candidate is hired; beyond that point, any further head start discourages the new hire more than it encourages the manager. The optimal contract therefore grants a head start just large enough to induce the manager to hire the strongest candidate.
abstract_zh: 我们研究在招聘中具有管理层自由裁量权的锦标赛。管理者从候选人池中挑选一位同事，然后在一个拉齐尔-罗森式锦标赛中与之竞争，奖品为总产出的一个份额。追求利润最大化的委托人设定奖品份额，同时给予管理者一个先发优势（或劣势）——即在产出比较中的优势（或劣势）。先发优势通过三个渠道影响产出：（i）激励管理者，（ii）抑制新员工，（iii）促使管理者招聘更强的候选人。在招聘到最强候选人之前，招聘效应主导抑制效应；超过该点后，任何进一步的先发优势对新员工的抑制程度超过对管理者的激励程度。因此，最优合同给予的先发优势恰好足以促使管理者招聘最强候选人。

title: Macroeconomic Impacts of China’s Energy Transition
title_zh: 中国能源转型的宏观经济影响
title_primary: 中国能源转型的宏观经济影响
title_secondary: Macroeconomic Impacts of China’s Energy Transition
authors: Hugo Rojas-Romagosa & Gregor Schwerhoff & Sneha D Thube & Sha Yu
official: 官方在线 2026-08-28 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Solar and wind power account for a growing share of electricity generation in China and now dominate new capacity additions. As the power system transitions toward renewable generation, greater flexibility will be required to maintain system stability. This paper uses a computable general equilibrium model to assess the macroeconomic implications of this transition. Model results indicate a modest increase in electricity prices in the near-term, followed by sustained declines as renewable shares rise, particularly when variability is managed through battery storage rather than coal-fired backup generation. While the transition requires substantial adjustments in electricity supply and investment, it raises GDP in the long run and strengthens energy security. Battery-based flexibility outperforms continued reliance on coal across multiple dimensions, even when accounting for rising electricity demand from emerging technologies such as artificial intelligence. However, this transition pathway also increases the risk of stranded assets in the coal power sector.
abstract_zh: 太阳能和风能在中国电力生产中所占份额日益增长，目前已成为新增装机容量的主导力量。随着电力系统向可再生能源转型，维持系统稳定性将需要更大的灵活性。本文运用可计算一般均衡模型评估这一转型的宏观经济影响。模型结果显示，短期内电价将温和上涨，随后随着可再生能源占比上升而持续下降，尤其是在通过电池储能而非燃煤备用发电来管理波动性的情况下。尽管这一转型要求电力供应和投资进行大幅调整，但从长远来看，它将提升国内生产总值并增强能源安全。即使在考虑人工智能等新兴技术带来的电力需求增长时，基于电池的灵活性方案在多个维度上仍优于继续依赖煤炭。然而，这一转型路径也增加了煤电行业资产搁浅的风险。

title: China's Dazzling Transport-infrastructure Growth: Measurement and Effects
title_zh: 中国交通基础设施的迅猛增长：测度与效应
title_primary: 中国交通基础设施的迅猛增长：测度与效应
title_secondary: China's Dazzling Transport-infrastructure Growth: Measurement and Effects
authors: Peter Egger, Nicole Loumeau, Gabriel Loumeau
official: 官方在线 2020-10-15 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We document an unprecedented change in the size and the quality of China's transport-infrastructure network between 2000 and 2013. This documentation is based on hand-collected and digitized data on roads and railways. The changes are summarized and portrayed as shortest-possible transport times of people and goods between 330 prefectures of mainland China. A quantitative model of China's prefectures and a Rest of the World, featuring both goods trade and migration, suggests that the long-run consequences of the transport-infrastructure changes induce regional convergence of lagging-behind prefectures in terms of population density and, to a lesser extent, in terms of real per-capita income. Not only changes in highway and high-speed-railway networks but also ones in lower-level road and railway networks are quantitatively important. Key drivers behind the effects are the facilitation of goods transport as well as technology diffusion, while the reduction of mobility costs and the diffusion of amenities appear less important.
abstract_zh: 我们记录了2000年至2013年间中国交通基础设施网络在规模与质量上的空前变化。这一记录基于手工收集并数字化的公路与铁路数据。这些变化被概括并描绘为中国大陆330个地级市之间人员与货物最短运输时间的变化。一个涵盖中国各地级市及世界其他地区、同时涉及商品贸易与人口迁移的量化模型表明，交通基础设施变化的长期后果促使落后地级市在人口密度方面实现区域趋同，而在实际人均收入方面的趋同程度则相对较小。不仅高速公路和高铁网络的变化，而且较低等级公路和铁路网络的变化，在数量上均具有重要意义。其影响背后的关键驱动因素在于促进了货物运输及技术扩散，而流动性成本的降低和便利设施的扩散则显得不那么重要。

title: Harmonizing Safety and Speed: A Human-Algorithm Approach to Enhance the FDA’s Medical Device Clearance Policy
title_zh: 协调安全与速度：人机算法协同优化FDA医疗器械审批政策
title_primary: 协调安全与速度：人机算法协同优化FDA医疗器械审批政策
title_secondary: Harmonizing Safety and Speed: A Human-Algorithm Approach to Enhance the FDA’s Medical Device Clearance Policy
authors: Mohammad Zhalechian, Soroush Saghafian, Omar Robles
official: 官方在线 2026-08-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The United States Food and Drug Administration (FDA)’s 510(k) pathway allows manufacturers to gain medical device approval by demonstrating substantial equivalence to a legally marketed device. However, the inherent ambiguity of this regulatory procedure has been associated with high recall among many devices cleared through this pathway, raising significant safety concerns. In this paper, we develop a combined human-algorithm approach to assist the FDA in improving its 510(k) medical device clearance process by reducing recall risk and regulatory workload. We first develop machine learning methods to estimate the risk of recall of 510(k) medical devices based on the information available at the time of submission. We then propose a data-driven clearance policy that recommends acceptance, rejection, or deferral to FDA’s committees for in-depth evaluation. We conduct an empirical study using a unique data set of over 31,000 submissions that we assembled based on data sources from the FDA and Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services. Compared to the FDA’s current practice, which has a recall rate of 10.3% and a normalized workload measure of 100%, a conservative evaluation of our policy shows a 32.9% improvement in the recall rate and a 40.5% reduction in the workload. Our analyses further suggest annual cost savings of approximately $1.7 billion for the healthcare system driven by avoided replacement costs, which is equivalent to 1.1% of the entire United States annual medical device expenditure. Our findings highlight the value of a holistic and data-driven approach to improve the FDA’s current 510(k) pathway. This paper was accepted by Stefan Scholtes, healthcare management. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06477 .
abstract_zh: 美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）的510(k)途径允许制造商通过证明其产品与已合法上市的器械具有实质性等同性来获得医疗器械批准。然而，这一监管程序固有的模糊性与该途径下许多器械的高召回率相关联，引发了重大的安全隐患。本文开发了一种结合人类与算法的综合方法，以协助FDA改进其510(k)医疗器械审批流程，旨在降低召回风险并减轻监管负担。我们首先利用机器学习方法，基于提交时可获得的信息来估计510(k)医疗器械的召回风险。随后，我们提出了一种数据驱动的审批政策，建议接受、拒绝或将产品转交FDA委员会进行深入评估。我们利用从FDA和医疗保险与医疗补助服务中心收集的数据源，构建了一个包含超过31,000份提交的独特数据集，并进行了实证研究。与FDA当前实践（召回率为10.3%，标准化工作量指标为100%）相比，我们政策的保守评估显示召回率改善了32.9%，工作量减少了40.5%。进一步分析表明，通过避免替换成本，每年可为医疗系统节省约17亿美元，这相当于美国全年医疗器械支出的1.1%。我们的研究结果凸显了采用整体性和数据驱动方法改进FDA现行510(k)途径的价值。本文由Stefan Scholtes（医疗管理领域）接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06477获取。

title: DP20890 School Choice, School Switching, and Optimal Assignment
title_zh: 学校选择、学校转换与最优配置
title_primary: 学校选择、学校转换与最优配置
title_secondary: DP20890 School Choice, School Switching, and Optimal Assignment
authors: Hessel Oosterbeek, Tina Rozsos, Bas van der Klaauw
official: 官方在线 2025-12-05 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Close to 20% of secondary school students in Amsterdam - and elsewhere - transfer between secondary schools at some point, even when initially placed in their most-preferred school. School switching is costly for the students involved and disrupts the learning environment of their former and new classmates. Using data from the Amsterdam secondary-school match linked to administrative registers, we show that switching can be predicted by hard-to-rationalize initial school choices. Over 60% of switchers can be correctly identified at the admission stage. Simulations indicate that encouraging predicted switchers to adjust their preference ranking of schools could reduce the switching rate by almost 15%.
abstract_zh: 阿姆斯特丹及其他地区约有近20%的中学学生在某个阶段会在学校之间转学，即便他们最初被分配到了最心仪的学校。转学对涉及的学生而言成本高昂，并扰乱了原班级和新班级同学的学习环境。利用与行政登记数据相连的阿姆斯特丹中学匹配数据，我们表明，转学行为可以通过难以理性化的初始学校选择来预测。超过60%的转学者能在录取阶段被准确识别。模拟结果显示，鼓励预测的转学者调整他们对学校的偏好排序，可将转学率降低近15%。

title: Race and Redistricting in Local Governments
title_zh: 地方政府中的种族与选区划分
title_primary: 地方政府中的种族与选区划分
title_secondary: Race and Redistricting in Local Governments
authors: Carlos Fernando Avenancio-León, Daniel B. Jones, Ying Shi
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Electoral maps translate residential geography into political representation, yet they have never been systematically measured for thousands of local governments across the country. We reconstruct 3,712 city council and county commission maps across 18,521 districts using nationwide voter-file and Census data. Enacted maps overrepresent White voters and underrepresent Black and Hispanic voters, with gaps predicting the racial composition of officeholders. We juxtapose these with simulated, race-blind maps satisfying common districting constraints. Simulated maps reproduce much of this disparity, showing that geography skews representation before any boundary-drawing. Enacted maps substantially improve on the race-blind baseline only in jurisdictions subject to oversight from the Voting Rights Act or districting litigation. As courts curtail race-conscious districting, local governments may revert to a baseline that is formally neutral but substantively unequal.
abstract_zh: 选举地图将居住地理转化为政治代表权，然而，在全国数千个地方政府中，这些地图从未被系统性地衡量过。我们利用全国选民档案和人口普查数据，重建了覆盖18,521个选区的3,712个市议会和县委员会地图。已实施的地图过度代表了白人选民，而低估了黑人和西班牙裔选民，这些差距预示着公职人员的种族构成。我们将这些地图与满足常见选区划分约束的模拟、种族盲视地图进行对比。模拟地图再现了大部分这种差异，表明在任何边界划定之前，地理就已经扭曲了代表权。只有在受《投票权法案》或选区划分诉讼监督的司法管辖区，已实施的地图才显著优于种族盲视基线。随着法院限制种族意识选区划分，地方政府可能回归到一种形式上中立但实质上不平等的基线状态。

title: Unequal Lives, Unequal Benefits: Life Expectancy and Social Security Rules
title_zh: 不平等寿命，不平等收益：预期寿命与社会保障规则
title_primary: 不平等寿命，不平等收益：预期寿命与社会保障规则
title_secondary: Unequal Lives, Unequal Benefits: Life Expectancy and Social Security Rules
authors: Javier Fernández-Blanco, Virginia Sánchez-Marcos
official: 官方在线 2026-06-13 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We examine the welfare costs of ignoring this observable information by incorporating either a wealth- or a health-based correction factor to the current program. For the analysis, we build a rich life-cycle model in which married men decide their savings, labor supply, and benefits-claiming age, and are heterogeneous in many dimensions, most notably their fixed health type. We find that the average welfare losses from ignoring wealth-related differences in life expectancy at the claiming age are equivalent to a 1.69% permanent reduction in consumption, with both health types experiencing welfare losses. By contrast, ignoring health-related information at the claiming age generates average welfare gains of 0.72%, but with highly uneven welfare effects across health types: while the tax burden of the transfers is concentrated largely among health type 1 individuals, health type 2 households experience a welfare loss equivalent to a 6.84% permanent consumption fall.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了在当前计划中纳入基于财富或健康的修正因子而忽略这一可观测信息所带来的福利成本。为进行分析，我们构建了一个丰富的生命周期模型，其中已婚男性决定其储蓄、劳动供给及领取福利的年龄，并在多个维度上具有异质性，尤其是其固定的健康类型。我们发现，在领取年龄时忽略与财富相关的预期寿命差异，平均福利损失相当于永久性消费减少1.69%，且两种健康类型均遭受福利损失。相比之下，在领取年龄时忽略与健康相关的信息，平均福利收益为0.72%，但不同健康类型间的福利效应极不均衡：虽然转移支付的税收负担主要集中在健康类型1个体身上，但健康类型2家庭经历的福利损失相当于永久性消费下降6.84%。

title: Common Risk Factors in the Returns on Stocks, Bonds (and Options), Redux
title_zh: 股票、债券（及期权）收益中的共同风险因素：重探
title_primary: 股票、债券（及期权）收益中的共同风险因素：重探
title_secondary: Common Risk Factors in the Returns on Stocks, Bonds (and Options), Redux
authors: Zhongtian Chen, Nikolai Roussanov, Xiaoliang Wang, Dongchen Zou
official: 官方在线 2026-08-10 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We identify a strong common risk factor structure that is pervasive across corporate securities: stocks, corporate bonds, and options. The common factors are closely linked to observable factors and key economic indicators. These factors explain much of the variation in individual asset returns, although pricing errors persist. A joint mean-variance efficient portfolio across asset classes achieves a high Sharpe ratio, resulting in part from cross-market hedging of the common sources of risk. We develop a measure of market segmentation based on differences in the common factor risk premia between markets and document a significant degree of segmentation.
abstract_zh: 我们识别出一种在企业证券中普遍存在的强共同风险因子结构：股票、公司债券和期权。这些共同因子与可观测因子及关键经济指标紧密相关。尽管定价误差持续存在，这些因子解释了个体资产收益的大部分变动。跨资产类别的联合均值-方差有效组合实现了较高的夏普比率，部分归因于对共同风险源的跨市场对冲。我们基于市场间共同因子风险溢价差异开发了一种市场分割度量，并记录了显著的分割程度。

title: Point scale framing and student performance: Evidence from a field experiment
title_zh: 分数制框架与学生表现：来自实地实验的证据
title_primary: 分数制框架与学生表现：来自实地实验的证据
title_secondary: Point scale framing and student performance: Evidence from a field experiment
authors: Puneet Arora, Arihant Jain, Ishita Tripathi
official: 官方在线 2026-08-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Does the numerical scale used to score an exam affect how hard students try? We test this question with a preregistered natural field experiment in which 1235 university students in India took identical tests framed as scored out of either 20 or 100 points. Exploiting both a high-stakes graded quiz and a zero-stakes additional test, we find no statistically or economically meaningful effects of the point-scale manipulation on test scores or on four effort measures, regardless of stakes, gender, or prior ability. These consistently null results, robust across settings, outcomes, and subgroups, identify a boundary condition for the numerosity heuristic: when scoring units are transparently arbitrary and evaluation ultimately rests on percentages, numerical rescaling does not shift behavior. The findings support the behavioral neutrality of a widely used and easily modified feature of assessment design.
abstract_zh: 考试评分所用的数值量表是否会影响学生的努力程度？我们通过一项预先注册的实地自然实验来检验这一问题，实验中，印度1235名大学生参加了以20分或100分为满分框架的相同测试。利用高风险的计分测验和零风险的附加测试，我们发现，无论风险高低、性别或先前能力如何，分数量表操作对测试成绩或四项努力指标均无统计学或经济意义上的显著影响。这些一致为零的结果，在不同情境、结果和子群体中均稳健，界定了数量启发式的一个边界条件：当评分单位明显随意且评估最终依赖于百分比时，数值重新标定不会改变行为。研究结果支持了评估设计中这一广泛使用且易于修改的特征在行为上的中性。

title: How do firms resolve patent disputes? Insights from competitive dynamics and market uncertainty
title_zh: 企业如何解决专利纠纷？来自竞争动态与市场不确定性的启示
title_primary: 企业如何解决专利纠纷？来自竞争动态与市场不确定性的启示
title_secondary: How do firms resolve patent disputes? Insights from competitive dynamics and market uncertainty
authors: Danmo Lin, Du Liu, A. Elizabeth Whalley
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-28 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We develop a real options model to examine the determinants of patent dispute outcomes between an incumbent firm and an allegedly infringing challenger. By analyzing their dynamic strategic interactions, we find that the gain-to-loss ratio, which reflects the degree of horizontal product differentiation, plays a crucial role in determining settlement feasibility, timing, and royalty terms. A lower gain-to-loss ratio, which indicates less differentiated products and more intense cannibalization, as well as higher market volatility, and a larger divergence in the firms’ financial incentives to continue litigation (ICL) reduce the likelihood of settlement. Our findings illustrate how product market differentiation, market uncertainty, and legal cost-allocation rules collectively determine whether firms accommodate entry through settlement or seek to preserve monopoly structures through litigation.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个实物期权模型，以考察在位企业与涉嫌侵权的挑战者之间专利争议结果的决定因素。通过分析其动态战略互动，我们发现损益比——反映横向产品差异化程度——在决定和解可行性、时机及许可条款方面起着关键作用。较低的损益比，表明产品差异化程度较小且替代效应更为激烈，加之更高的市场波动性，以及企业继续诉讼财务激励（ICL）差异的扩大，均会降低和解的可能性。我们的研究结果阐明了产品市场差异化、市场不确定性及法律成本分配规则如何共同决定企业是通过和解来适应进入，还是通过诉讼来寻求维持垄断结构。

title: Why are the youngest in class more often prescribed pharmacological treatment for ADHD?
title_zh: 为何班级中最年幼的学生更常被开具ADHD药物治疗？

authors: Catia Nicodemo, Cheti Nicoletti, Joaquim Vidiella-Martin
official: 官方在线 2026-07-23 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Children who start school at a younger age are more likely to receive pharmacological treatment for attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD). This pattern is widely attributed to peer-comparison biases, but the relative importance of different underlying mechanisms remains debated. We use administrative data from England to study how school starting age affects ADHD prescription rates from ages 5 to 15. Exploiting a sharp school-entry cutoff and comparing children born just before and after September 1, we estimate both age- and grade-specific effects of early school entry. We find that early starters are 40–50% more likely to be treated for ADHD by age 15. This long-term gap is entirely driven by first-time prescriptions among children aged 5 to 8. Using a novel decomposition strategy, we isolate the roles of relative age, absolute age, the length of school exposure, and age at school entry. We find that relative age is the primary long-term driver, aligning with previous evidence on peer-comparison bias, while absolute age and the length of school exposure have only short-lived effects. Our findings suggest that early starters are more likely to receive marginal diagnoses due to their relative immaturity, and we recommend refining diagnostic guidelines and classroom grouping practices to reduce diagnostic gaps.
abstract_zh: 入学年龄较小的儿童更可能因注意缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）接受药物治疗。这一现象被广泛归因于同伴比较偏差，但不同潜在机制的重要性仍存争议。我们利用英格兰行政数据，研究入学年龄如何影响5至15岁儿童的ADHD处方率。通过利用严格的入学年龄截止日期，并比较9月1日前后的出生儿童，我们估算了早期入学对年龄和年级的特定影响。研究发现，早期入学儿童在15岁时接受ADHD治疗的可能性高出40%-50%。这一长期差距完全由5至8岁儿童的首次处方驱动。采用新的分解策略，我们分离了相对年龄、绝对年龄、在校时长及入学年龄的作用。结果表明，相对年龄是主要的长期驱动因素，与先前关于同伴比较偏差的证据一致，而绝对年龄和在校时长仅产生短期效应。我们的发现表明，早期入学儿童因相对不成熟更易获得边缘性诊断，并建议完善诊断指南和课堂分组实践以减少诊断差距。

title: Financial Market Infrastructures Evolution in a Tokenized Economy
title_zh: 代币化经济中金融市场基础设施的演进
title_primary: 代币化经济中金融市场基础设施的演进
title_secondary: Financial Market Infrastructures Evolution in a Tokenized Economy
authors: Yaiza Cabedo & Mr. Tommaso Mancini-Griffoli & Fabian Schär & Nicolas Zhang
official: 官方在线 2026-07-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper examines how tokenization and distributed ledger technology may transform Financial Market Infrastructures (FMIs) by enabling smart contracts to perform a growing share of functions traditionally undertaken by central securities depositories, central counterparties, and trade repositories. It argues that while record-keeping, settlement, collateral management, and reporting can increasingly be executed on-chain, key functions requiring legal certainty, governance, accountability, and discretion remain institutional in nature. The analysis assesses which activities across issuance, clearing, settlement, and reporting can migrate to code, where limitations persist, and how risks evolve in tokenized environments. It finds that tokenization is more likely to reconfigure than eliminate FMIs, creating new efficiencies while introducing novel operational and governance risks. The most plausible outcome is a hybrid FMI model in which technology and institutions jointly provide the trust, resilience, and oversight required for financial stability.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨代币化与分布式账本技术如何通过使智能合约承担中央证券存管机构、中央对手方及交易数据库等传统金融基础设施（FMIs）中日益增多的职能，从而推动其变革。研究指出，尽管记录保存、结算、抵押品管理及报告等环节可逐步迁移至链上执行，但涉及法律确定性、治理、问责及自由裁量权的关键职能仍具有制度属性。本文系统评估了发行、清算、结算及报告等环节中哪些活动可迁移至代码执行、现存局限性所在，以及代币化环境下风险演变特征。研究发现，代币化更可能重构而非消除金融基础设施，在创造新效率的同时引入新型操作与治理风险。最可能的结果是形成混合型金融基础设施模式——技术与机构共同提供金融稳定所需的信任、韧性及监管能力。

title_secondary: Is the distribution of resolvable uncertainty Type I extreme value? A test for random coefficient models using choice probabilities
authors: Romuald Méango
official: 来源期次 2026-07-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Probabilistic stated choices allow respondents to express uncertainty about their intended decisions. They are typically paired with random-coefficient models (RCM) that impose Type I extreme value (EV1) resolvable uncertainty. This paper proposes a test of these assumptions based on the restrictions imposed by the EV1 distribution on the population distribution of interquantile ranges of ex ante returns. Our test is rejected in four studies published in leading economics journals. In these applications, EV1-based estimators often perform reasonably well for median willingness-to-pay (WTP), but are less reliable for distributional objects such as the full WTP distribution.
abstract_zh: 概率性陈述选择允许受访者表达对其预期决策的不确定性。这类选择通常与随机系数模型（RCM）配对使用，该模型施加了第一类极值（EV1）可解析的不确定性。本文基于EV1分布对事前收益的群体分位数间距分布所施加的限制，提出了一种检验这些假设的方法。我们的检验在发表于顶级经济学期刊的四项研究中被拒绝。在这些应用中，基于EV1的估计器通常对中位数支付意愿（WTP）表现良好，但在诸如完整WTP分布等分布性对象上则可靠性较低。

official: 官方在线 2026-06-23 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper examines the link between higher education and fertility, with particular attention to the role of intergenerational educational mobility in shaping this relationship. Drawing on data from the 1970 British Cohort Study, we estimate differences in completed fertility across three groups: first-in-family university graduates (FiF), graduates with at least one university-educated parent (non-FiF graduates), and individuals who did not attend university (non-graduates). Our findings show that although graduate women generally have fewer children than non-graduates, this gap is primarily driven by FiF graduates. FiF women have lower fertility than both non-FiF graduates and non-graduates, who exhibit similar fertility patterns. The fertility gap between FiF and non-FiF graduates emerges after age 35, mainly on the extensive margin: FiF women are more likely to remain childless, but those who become mothers have an average number of children similar to non-FiF graduates. Similar patterns are observed for men, however, the gaps are smaller and not statistically significant. We identify child-related preferences, self-esteem, and exposure to maternal employment during childhood as potential drivers of the relationship between FiF status and fertility. In contrast, labour market outcomes, financial constraints, partnership status, and health outcomes do not appear to contribute to the FiF fertility gap. These findings highlight key considerations for policies aimed at supporting both intergenerational mobility and fertility.
abstract_zh: 在集体出发游泳赛段中跟游所产生的流体力学成本优势会转移至自行车与跑步阶段，并表现为相对排名的变化。本文以跨赛段排名提升作为搭便车行为的反向代理指标，基于以2020年为中心的十年期运动员×赛事面板数据，研究其决定因素——2020年新冠疫情应对政策将集体出发改为间隔出发，从机制上限制了跟游行为。通过构建紧凑的两阶段竞赛模型（将跟游作为乘数型成本转移因子纳入自行车-跑步阶段）来组织预测。识别策略结合了混合OLS回归、运动员与赛事固定效应，以及以2019/2020年为断点的锐化回归断点设计。2020年前搭便车现象显著，2020年急剧下降（局部线性RDD估计值约为-31个排名位次；局部立方估计值约为-92），此后仅部分恢复。游泳能力较弱的运动员和跟游位置更靠后的选手获益最大，性别差异较小，且收益随游泳组规模扩大而增加（估计对数-对数弹性约为0.43）。因此，2020年的冲击相当于收缩了搭便车的可行集，其恢复呈现非均衡特征而非全面复苏。

title_zh: 国内需求还是贸易报复？中国对美国加征关税的政策回应
title_primary: 国内需求还是贸易报复？中国对美国加征关税的政策回应
title_secondary: Domestic Demand or Trade Retaliation? China's Policy Responses to U.S. Tariff Hikes
authors: Zhijie Jia, Shiyan Wen, Rongxin Wu
official: 官方在线 2026-06-18 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Rising deglobalization has increased external uncertainty for the global economy. This paper develops a China–US Trade Equilibrium (CUTE) model that integrates monetary mechanisms and Hicksian welfare decomposition to examine the effects of U.S. tariff hikes on China and the U.S., as well as China's policy responses. A key contribution is the comparison of policy responses under identical policy costs. The results show that the direct macroeconomic impact of U.S. tariffs on China is modest, reflecting limited trade exposure and strong substitution effects, while broad tariffs generate larger welfare losses for the America through price increases and real income erosion. The reaction directly supporting household income and consumption yield substantially higher welfare returns than trade retaliation, government spending or monetary easing, as tariffs reduce real purchasing power. We suggest within the institutional settings considered, prioritizing household‐based demand support is a more effective response to external tariff shocks than retaliatory trade measures.
abstract_zh: 去全球化趋势加剧了全球经济的外部不确定性。本文构建了一个整合货币机制与希克斯福利分解的中美贸易均衡（CUTE）模型，用以考察美国加征关税对中国和美国的影响，以及中国的政策应对。本文的关键贡献在于，在相同政策成本条件下比较了不同政策应对的效果。研究结果表明，美国关税对中国的直接宏观经济影响较为温和，这反映了有限的贸易敞口和较强的替代效应；而广泛性关税则通过价格上涨和实际收入侵蚀，给美国带来更大的福利损失。相较于贸易报复、政府支出或货币宽松政策，直接支持家庭收入和消费的应对措施能产生显著更高的福利回报，原因在于关税削弱了实际购买力。我们建议，在所考虑的体制环境下，优先采取基于家庭的需求支持政策，是应对外部关税冲击比报复性贸易措施更为有效的策略。

official: 官方在线 2026-06-14 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Off‐label use regulation has the potential to change pharmaceutical firms' behavior and—consequently—affect patient welfare. We investigate the impact of changes in off‐label regulation on pharmaceutical firms' behavior in seeking formal marketing approval for supplemental uses. In 2012, a US court decision protected truthful off‐label promotion, providing pharmaceutical companies more leeway to promote off‐label uses of their drug. Using a unique data set of pharmaceutical firms' research and development projects, we exploit this regulatory change to understand how firms react to government policies. Results demonstrate that the hazard of approval declined for supplemental uses, relative to original uses, after the policy change. Patent protection, potential market size, and competition are also important determinants of the hazard of approval. These results have implications not only for innovation policy but for the creation of high‐quality data for certain indications.
abstract_zh: 超说明书用药监管可能改变制药企业的行为，进而影响患者福利。本文研究了超说明书用药监管变化对制药企业寻求补充用途正式上市许可行为的影响。2012年美国一项法院裁决保护了真实的超说明书推广行为，使制药公司获得更大空间推广其药物的超说明书用途。我们利用制药企业研发项目的独特数据集，借助这一监管变化来理解企业如何应对政府政策。结果表明，政策变化后，补充用途相较于原始用途的获批风险有所下降。专利保护、潜在市场规模和竞争也是影响获批风险的重要因素。这些发现不仅对创新政策具有启示意义，也对特定适应症高质量数据的生成产生影响。

title: When information and communication are both costly
title_zh: 信息与沟通成本高昂时
title_primary: 信息与沟通成本高昂时
title_secondary: When information and communication are both costly
authors: Shahir Safi
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-15 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: I consider environments where an upwardly-biased expert faces both costs of acquiring information and of “transmitting inaccurate information relative to the realized state” (forecasting error) when advising a decision-maker. While existing models study these costs separately, I show that considering them jointly can substantially alter standard results. Introducing costly information acquisition overturns the partial-communication and language-inflation predictions of models with bounded messages and costly communication: equilibrium communication features truth-telling and full transmission of the acquired information. At the same time, communication costs can reverse the structure of optimal information acquisition, shifting from partitions with decreasing interval lengths to partitions with increasing interval lengths when misreporting is sufficiently more costly than acquisition. Finally, information acquisition costs generate an acquisition–transmission dilemma: the expert never acquires information that cannot be credibly communicated, implying that perfect information acquisition is impossible.
abstract_zh: 我考察了在向上偏误的专家面临信息获取成本及“相对于已实现状态的传递不准确信息”（预测误差）成本时，为决策者提供建议的环境。现有模型分别研究这些成本，但我表明，将它们联合考虑可能显著改变标准结论。引入昂贵的信息获取推翻了有界消息和昂贵沟通模型中的部分沟通与语言膨胀预测：均衡沟通特征为诚实报告及所获信息的完全传递。同时，沟通成本可逆转最优信息获取的结构，当误报成本显著高于获取成本时，从区间长度递减的分区转向区间长度递增的分区。最后，信息获取成本产生获取-传递困境：专家从不获取无法可信沟通的信息，这意味着完美信息获取是不可能的。

official: Crossref 元数据日期 2025-12-08 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Abstract Prior research suggests that students exposed to domestic violence impose substantial negative externalities on peers’ learning and labor market outcomes. We test whether these findings generalize using nine-years of student data from a large urban school district linked to geocoded police records of at-home violence. In contrast to prior work, we find negligible peer effects. Adding one exposed peer to a classroom of 20 students reduces English and math scores by a statistically insignificant 0.006 standard deviations and increases disciplinary incidents by 3.2%. We reject achievement reductions greater than 0.017 standard deviations and disciplinary increases larger than 8.3%.
abstract_zh: 先前研究表明，遭受家庭暴力的学生会对同伴的学习及劳动力市场结果产生显著的负面外部效应。我们利用一个大城市学区九年的学生数据，结合地理编码的警方家庭暴力记录，检验这些发现是否具有普遍性。与先前研究相反，我们发现同伴效应微乎其微。在一个20名学生的班级中增加一名受暴露同伴，会使英语和数学成绩下降0.006个标准差，但统计上不显著，同时纪律事件增加3.2%。我们排除了成绩下降超过0.017个标准差及纪律事件增加超过8.3%的可能性。

title: Italy's long‐term economic performance: GDP estimates from 1300 to 1861

title_primary: 意大利长期经济表现：1300年至1861年的GDP估算
title_secondary: Italy's long‐term economic performance: GDP estimates from 1300 to 1861
authors: Giovanni Federico, Alessandro Nuvolari, Leonardo Ridolfi, Michelangelo Vasta
official: 官方在线 2025-10-22 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We present new demand‐side estimates of gross domestic product (GDP) per capita for Italy and its two macro‐areas, Centre‐North and South, for the pre‐industrial period (1328–1861) on the basis of a novel dataset including almost 100,000 observations from 169 different locations. Our estimates confirm the chronology of the ‘Little Divergence’ relative to the Netherlands and England. Italy maintained its leading position relative to the other European countries and was overtaken by France and Germany only in the first half of the nineteenth century. GDP per capita trends differed between Centre‐North and South determining a ‘slow‐motion’ divergence of the South from the fifteenth century to political unification.
abstract_zh: 我们基于一个包含近10万条观测数据、覆盖169个不同地点的新数据集，为意大利及其两个宏观区域——中北部和南部——在工业化前时期（1328-1861年）提供了人均国内生产总值（GDP）的新需求侧估算。我们的估算结果证实了与荷兰和英格兰相比的“小分流”时间线。意大利相对于其他欧洲国家保持了领先地位，直到19世纪上半叶才被法国和德国超越。中北部与南部的人均GDP趋势差异，决定了从15世纪到政治统一期间南部“缓慢变动”的分化过程。

title: The Willingness to Pay for Flood Insurance
title_zh: 洪水保险的支付意愿
title_primary: 洪水保险的支付意愿
title_secondary: The Willingness to Pay for Flood Insurance
authors: Netusil, N. R., Kousky, C., Neupane, S., Daniel, W., Kunreuther, H.
official: 官方在线 2021-08-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Flooding is the natural disaster that causes the most damage. Postflood, many families are not insured and do not have sufficient savings for rebuilding, and governmental aid can be limited. We undertake, using a stated preference survey, the first willingness-to-pay (WTP) elicitation for flood insurance in the United States. WTP increases with modeled flood risk and flood-risk perceptions. WTP for residents in our study area’s 100-year floodplain is 47% to 59% of the median flood insurance premium, which suggests the need for financial assistance for families who are at risk of flood damage and are unable to afford risk-based premiums. abstract_zh: 洪水是造成损失最严重的自然灾害。灾后，许多家庭既未投保，也缺乏足够的储蓄用于重建，而政府援助可能有限。我们通过一项陈述偏好调查，首次在美国进行了洪水保险支付意愿（WTP）的测度。支付意愿随模拟洪水风险和洪水风险认知的增加而提高。我们研究区域内百年一遇洪水淹没区居民的支付意愿为洪水保险中位保费的47%至59%，这表明，对于面临洪水风险且无力承担基于风险的保费的家庭，有必要提供财务援助。JEL Q54Q58 本开放获取文章依据CC-BY-NC-ND许可协议（http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-nd/4.0）分发，并可在以下网址免费在线获取：http://le.uwpress.org。
